summary.text: Sharon Wylie represents the Vancouver, Washington community in the Washington House of Representatives, where her official biography says she was appointed in 2011. She serves on the House Environment & Energy, Transportation and Finance committees.

paragraphs.text: Before her appointment, Wylie was Government Relations Officer for Clark County and several other county and transportation organizations, according to her official biography.
The page says she has more than 25 years of management, government relations and leadership experience in business, non-profit and government.
The page says she was appointed to the Washington State Arts Commission in 2019 and has chaired the Regulated Substances and Gaming Committee.
It says she was a Council of State Governments Henry Toll Fellow for the class of 2013.
In her district, the page says she has served as president of the Council for the Homeless and as a board member of Affordable Community Environments.
It says she earned a BA in Political Science from UC Riverside.
